description: Defines a TRPC router for window management functions (maximize, restore, minimize, fullscreen, window state change subscription) in the Notesnook desktop application.

methods.name: maximize
methods.description: Mutates the window to maximize it.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores the window to its previous size.

methods.name: maximized
methods.description: Queries if the window is maximized.

methods.name: fullscreen
methods.description: Queries if the window is in full screen mode.

methods.name: onWindowStateChanged
methods.description: Subscribes to window state change events (maximize, minimize, fullscreen).
